task: Edit these navigation link labels to be descriptive and self-explanatory when read without surrounding visual context. Replace vague or generic labels using only the supplied destination facts.
input: Home | Info | Click here | Stuff | Contact

facts.text: The Home link goes to the homepage.
The Info link goes to the About the Press page.
The Click here link goes to the current catalogue of titles.
The Stuff link goes to a Free Resources section.
The Contact link goes to the contact form.

Stuff as a final link label.
An invented destination not from the supplied facts.
preserve: About the Press (or equivalent) for the Info link.
